translations.web: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.
translations.bsb: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.
translations.kjv: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
translations.asv: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is of heaven.
